question: dame los diez comercios de más volumen, con su volumen en euros y su cuota en porcentaje sobre el total
sql: SELECT m.merchant_id, SUM(sb.gross_eur_minor) AS volume_eur, 100.0 * SUM(sb.gross_eur_minor) / SUM(sb.gross_eur_minor) OVER () AS share_pct FROM fact_settlement_batch sb JOIN dim_merchant_current m ON m.merchant_sk = sb.merchant_id WHERE m.is_active = true AND m.is_current = true GROUP BY m.merchant_id ORDER BY volume_eur DESC LIMIT 10
